name: Sudden stop of activity and withdrawal of funds before VAT due
description: Account activity ceases and balances drain just before VAT returns fall due.
fp: May have innocent explanations; assess in context of customer profile and other indicators.

sources.text: Europol and EU bodies, public material on missing trader intra-community (MTIC) fraud
OECD, Technology Tools to Tackle Tax Evasion and Tax Fraud (2017)
FATF/OECD, Money Laundering Awareness Handbook for Tax Examiners and Tax Auditors (2012)
Council Directive 2006/112/EC on the common system of value added tax
